```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(lubridate)
library(svglite)
library(kableExtra)
library(showtext)

setwd(here::here())

#font_add_google("IBM Plex Sans", "ibm")
extrafont::loadfonts()
week_sel=7

pretty_table <- function(x){
  kable(x) %>%
    kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover"),
      full_width = FALSE,
      position = "left"
    )
}

source("scripts/league_data.R")
```

[See all the recaps for the 2026 season](https://jshannon75.github.io/pcfl/)

## Week `r week_sel` Headlines

* Clairvoyant is transcendent (but his bench is not)
* The Hobbits' bench almost outscores the starters
* Pigskin on the Gridiron has a top 5 week
* Jaheims vs Sharks: this week's prime matchup

## Last week's games

```{r}
#| echo: false
pretty_table(lastweek_results)
```

The marquee matchup was Brian vs. Ted/Elaine. Scoring was relatively modest, but in the end, as ESPN's AI (roughly) put it, in a "Monday Night Miracle," "CeeDee Lamb showed his love for Captain Clairvoyant." Congratulations to our only unbeaten team, who's now at the top of our league standings.

Tough week for mythical creatures: both the Hobbits and Sasquatch lost in blowouts.

## Best performances

### Best players overall
Here's last week's **10 best performing players.** 

```{r}
#| echo: false
pretty_table(top_n(starters,10,Points) %>%
        arrange(-Points))
```

Look at you, Tony Pollard. Also, JSN is really good at football.

### Best bench
Who won the **best scoring bench** award last week?

```{r}
#| echo: false
pretty_table(starter_benchteam %>% 
        arrange(-`Bench points`) %>%
  rename(Team=`PCFL Team`))
```

Brian may be unbeaten, but he won this week with only 2.8 points on his bench. It's a thin margin!

#### Season bench standings

```{r}
 rename(Team=name))
```

### Waiver masters

I've tallied the players picked up by each team since the draft and the points they've contributed as starters. Here's where those stand.

```{r}
#| echo: false
pretty_table(roster_pickup %>%
        select(-abbrev) %>%
        rename(Team=name,Points=draftpoints,
               Transactions=draft_num) %>%
        arrange(-Points)) 
```

### Recapping the draft
Here's the amount of points drafted players have contributed to each team as starters.

```{r}
#| echo: false
pretty_table(roster_draft %>%

        rename(Team=name,Points=draftpoints) %>% 
        arrange(-Points))
```

## Looking ahead

### League standings

Our league standings are a little unusual. We rank teams based on points, kinda like hockey. There are two ways to get points:

* Win your weekly matchup (1 point)
* Finish in the top six point scorers (1 point)

```{r}
#| echo: false
pretty_table(standings)
```

Still a clear top 4 here, with Brian on top. Richard, Erin/Trav, and Robbie are lurking, though.

### Playoff Odds

I've created 10,000 simulations of the remaining matchups based on teams' performances so far. Here's what playoff odds look like based on those results:

```{r}
#| echo: false
pretty_table(playoff_odds %>%
  mutate(
    Odds      = scales::percent(PlayoffOdds, accuracy = 0.1),
    TopSeed   = scales::percent(TopSeed, accuracy = 0.1),
    AvgSeed   = round(AvgSeed, 2),
    ExpPoints = round(ExpPoints, 1)
  ) %>%
  select(Team = name, Odds, TopSeed, AvgSeed, ExpPoints))
```

Despite the unbeaten record, Sarah has a **slightly** better chance for the playoffs. 

Not looking good for the Hobbits, the GOAT, and my Peanuts.
